_about: Real Indian retail health plans. Every value carries its source URL. verified=false means the value came from a web-search reading of that page and has NOT yet been checked against the policy wording by `python -m healthcompare.ingest`. Missing criteria are unknown, not 'no'. Premiums are not included yet; they come from the prospectus premium tables. Insurer CSR uses one definition for all insurers (Ditto's computation from public disclosures); ICR from the IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 via Business Standard. Replace with IRDAI primary tables when reachable.

csr_count.note: Claims settled (full + partial) / (brought forward + reported - closed without payment - outstanding at year end), by number, computed by an IRDAI-registered broker (Ditto) from the insurer's public disclosures. Same definition for every insurer.

alternates.note: Unclear definition. The same post's Star Health figure matches a 'claims settled within 3 months' timeliness metric, so these may not be claim settlement ratios at all.

icr.note: Net incurred claims / net earned premium (health segment for multi-line insurers), IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25, as reported by Business Standard.

complaints_per_10k.note: Figure from a web-search summary of IRDAI complaint data (pages: nyvo.in, algatesinsurance.in, business-standard.com); exact page not pinned.
